description: This file implements the IdentityCredentialStore class, providing methods to retrieve hardware info, create credentials, and get credentials, within the Android identity hardware namespace.

classes.name: IdentityCredentialStore
classes.description: Implements the methods for managing identity credentials, including hardware info retrieval, credential creation, and credential retrieval.

methods.name: getHardwareInformation
methods.description: Retrieves information about the hardware backing the credential store, such as name, author, chunk size, and supported document types.

methods.name: createCredential
methods.description: Creates a new writable identity credential for a specified document type, with an option for test credentials.

methods.name: getCredential
methods.description: Retrieves an identity credential based on the specified cipher suite and credential data.
